newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers at a typical Monday standoff, USDA said. Bids were light at $112.00 per cwt, and many owners were pricing stock $114.00-$115.00. Last sales mostly $112.00 on Thursday.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Confirmed - None Last Week - 1,000 Last Year - 5,000
For week - 200 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 4,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 8,800
